name: Sticker collage layering
summary: A dense layer of cut-out stickers, each with a white border and a hard shadow, that overlap on a bright ground.
how: Cut each motif with a white border of 6px.
Add a hard shadow of 3px to 4px in near black under each sticker.
Rotate each sticker by -6° to +6° and overlap neighbours by 8px to 24px.
Fill 60% to 80% of the frame, and keep one sticker larger than the rest as the focus.

origin.note: The messaging app LINE adds sticker sets, and the die-cut sticker becomes a screen object.

adoptions.via: Kidcore pages and images stack die-cut stickers with white borders over bright grounds.
